extDescription.message: Sends videos from the page you are on to the Video-Catcher download manager.

sendPageHint.message: Best for sites yt-dlp knows (YouTube, Vimeo, ARD, many more).

nothingFound.message: Nothing found yet. Start the video on the page; if the page offers several players or hosts, click one. Then it shows up here. If the page was open before the extension was installed or updated, reload it first.

withCookiesHint.message: Only for videos you can only watch when logged in. The cookies go to Video-Catcher on this PC and nowhere else. Without the tick, only the proof that a site's bot check (Cloudflare) let your browser in goes along.

notConnected.message: Video-Catcher is not connected. In Video-Catcher, open Settings and turn on "Allow the browser extension". Video-Catcher must be version 0.2.0 or newer.

allowSitesHint.message: Without it the extension cannot see the videos a page loads.

errBadLink.message: Video-Catcher does not accept this link.

errStart.message: Video-Catcher could not be started. The link waits and is taken at its next start.

blobVideo.message: This video has no link of its own (blob). The page was sent instead.

kindEmbed.message: Embedded player: its page is sent. That only works for sites yt-dlp knows; a stream from the list is the better choice

hiddenVideo.message: A video is playing here, but the page keeps its stream out of sight. "Send this page" or a player listed below only work for sites yt-dlp knows. If you opened the page before the extension was installed or updated, reload it and start the video again. Still nothing? Use "Copy a report" below.

reportHint.message: Video not found? Play it, then copy the report and add it to an issue. Links in it are shortened, logins are left out.

reportCopied.message: Copied. Paste it into your issue.

reportFailed.message: The report could not be copied. Reload the page, play the video and try again.
